1→from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List
     2→from .base import BaseModel
     3→import asyncpg
     4→
     5→class SourceChatModel(BaseModel):
     6→    """Model for managing source chats"""
     7→    
     8→    def __init__(self, db):
     9→        super().__init__(db)
    10→        self.table_name = "source_chats"
    11→    
    12→    async def get_all_sources(self) -> List[asyncpg.Record]:
    13→        """Get all source chats globally"""
    14→        query = """
    15→            SELECT sc.*, COUNT(scu.id) as user_count,
    16→                   COUNT(rr.id) as route_count
    17→            FROM source_chats sc
    18→            LEFT JOIN source_chat_users scu ON scu.source_chat_id = sc.id
    19→            LEFT JOIN routing_rules rr ON rr.source_chat_id = sc.id AND rr.enabled = true
    20→            GROUP BY sc.id
    21→            ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC
    22→        """
    23→        return await self.db.fetch(query)
    24→    
    25→    async def get_by_group(self, group_id: int) -> List[asyncpg.Record]:
    26→        """Get all source chats routed to a specific group"""
    27→        query = """
    28→            SELECT sc.*, COUNT(scu.id) as user_count
    29→            FROM source_chats sc
    30→            LEFT JOIN source_chat_users scu ON scu.source_chat_id = sc.id
    31→            LEFT JOIN routing_rules rr ON rr.source_chat_id = sc.id
    32→            WHERE rr.target_group_id = $1 AND rr.enabled = true
    33→            GROUP BY sc.id
    34→            ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC
    35→        """
    36→        return await self.db.fetch(query, group_id)
    37→    
    38→    async def add_source(self, source_chat_id: int, source_type: str, 
    39→                        name: str = None, title: str = None) -> asyncpg.Record:
    40→        """Add a new global source chat"""
    41→        query = """
    42→            INSERT INTO source_chats (source_chat_id, source_type, name, title)
    43→            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
    44→            ON CONFLICT (source_chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
    45→                source_type = $2, name = $3, title = $4, enabled = true
    46→            RETURNING *
    47→        """
    48→        return await self.db.fetchrow(query, source_chat_id, source_type, name, title)
    49→    
    50→    async def add_routing_rule(self, source_id: int, target_group_id: int) -> asyncpg.Record:
    51→        """Add a routing rule from source to target group"""
    52→        query = """
    53→            INSERT INTO routing_rules (source_chat_id, target_group_id)
    54→            VALUES ($1, $2)
    55→            ON CONFLICT (source_chat_id, target_group_id) DO UPDATE SET
    56→                enabled = true
    57→            RETURNING *
    58→        """
    59→        return await self.db.fetchrow(query, source_id, target_group_id)
    60→    
    61→    async def get_routing_rules(self, source_id: int) -> List[asyncpg.Record]:
    62→        """Get all routing rules for a source"""
    63→        query = """
    64→            SELECT rr.*, g.title as group_title, g.tg_chat_id
    65→            FROM routing_rules rr
    66→            JOIN groups g ON g.id = rr.target_group_id
    67→            WHERE rr.source_chat_id = $1
    68→            ORDER BY rr.enabled DESC, g.title
    69→        """
    70→        return await self.db.fetch(query, source_id)
    71→    
    72→    async def remove_routing_rule(self, source_id: int, target_group_id: int) -> bool:
    73→        """Remove a routing rule"""
    74→        query = "DELETE FROM routing_rules WHERE source_chat_id = $1 AND target_group_id = $2"
    75→        result = await self.db.execute(query, source_id, target_group_id)
    76→        return result.split()[-1] == '1'
    77→    
    78→    async def toggle_enabled(self, source_id: int) -> bool:
    79→        """Toggle source chat enabled status"""
    80→        query = """
    81→            UPDATE source_chats 
    82→            SET enabled = NOT enabled 
    83→            WHERE id = $1 
    84→            RETURNING enabled
    85→        """
    86→        return await self.db.fetchval(query, source_id)
    87→    
    88→    async def remove_source(self, source_id: int) -> bool:
    89→        """Remove a source chat"""
